en.text: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

zhSimplified.text: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我。

zhTraditional.text: 我在急難中求告耶和華， 他就應允我。

en.text: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇和诡诈的舌头！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離說謊的嘴唇和詭詐的舌頭！

en.text: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

zhSimplified.text: 诡诈的舌头啊，要给你什么呢？ 要拿什么加给你呢？

zhTraditional.text: 詭詐的舌頭啊，要給你甚麼呢？ 要拿甚麼加給你呢？

en.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

zhSimplified.text: 就是勇士的利箭和罗腾木 的炭火。

zhTraditional.text: 就是勇士的利箭和羅騰木 的炭火。

en.text: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

zhSimplified.text: 我寄居在米设， 住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了！

zhTraditional.text: 我寄居在米設， 住在基達帳棚之中，有禍了！

en.text: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

zhSimplified.text: 我与那恨恶和睦的人许久同住。

zhTraditional.text: 我與那恨惡和睦的人許久同住。

en.text: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

zhSimplified.text: 我愿和睦， 但我发言，他们就要争战。

zhTraditional.text: 我願和睦， 但我發言，他們就要爭戰。
